title: Wakir persona-definition canonical subset (V-907, persona-v2 / V10)
description: persona-v2 schema, additive-only successor to persona-v1 per engine-default Default-Lock A-2 (semver-major-only + additiv-only + linear chain). Adds two top-level optional fields (model_pin, spawn_constraints), three optional fields under identity_pinned (identity_doc_ref, persona_owner_role, governance_revision), and reserves three top-level keys (recovery_drill, wat_bridge_overrides, container_bridge_spec) without defining semantics. Anti-changes: no field removal, no type narrowing, no required-set extension, no body changes, no JCS-norm change, no hash-function change. Field semantics for additive and reserved fields are HR-slot-ratification-pending (ADR-0029-Annex). The markdown body is OUT-OF-HASH and intentionally NOT covered by this schema.

name.description: Subagent slug / role-string per Brand-Guide §9. Never a clear personal name.

description.description: Spawn-time human-readable description (also used as the dispatcher hint for the parent supervisor).

tools.description: Allow-list of tool names this persona may invoke (Read, Glob, Bash, etc.).

identity_pinned.description: Authority and cross-review parameters that are part of the persona's audit-pinned surface. v2 adds three optional fields (identity_doc_ref, persona_owner_role, governance_revision) on top of the v1 required-set.

identity_doc_ref.description: OPTIONAL. Forward-link to a Z-L identity-substrate document hash (identity-eng-slot domain, Zone L). HR-slot-ratification-pending; identity-eng-slot Forward-link-pending. Format is a URI string; precise URI scheme is Sprint-3-Tag-N consensus item.

persona_owner_role.description: OPTIONAL. HR-side ownership role-string, distinct from hierarchy.reports_to (which is reporting/escalation only). hr-slot domain ratification.

governance_revision.description: OPTIONAL. Allows persona-definition governance revisions to be pinned without forcing a schema-version shift. Distinct from schema_version (engine-side) and from file-level git history (operator-side).

model_pin.description: OPTIONAL. Carries an explicit model-version pin so a persona's behaviour is reproducible across model upgrades. Phase-2 alignment item; Sprint-3 records the hash-input shape so v2-inputs that supply it are byte-stable. Field semantics HR-slot-ratification-pending (ADR-0029-Annex).

spawn_constraints.description: OPTIONAL. Captures spawn-time validations (e.g. parent-supervisor allow-list, max-concurrent-instances). Currently lives implicitly in supervisor code; v2 makes it persona-pinnable. Field semantics HR-slot-ratification-pending.

recovery_drill.description: RESERVED, no semantics in persona-v2. Anticipated owner: identity-eng-slot (recovery-drill-leaf-projection.md may want a persona-pin slot for drill membership). Reserved-but-empty hashes the same as absent under the canonical-subset extractor's drop-empty discipline (Default-Lock A-2 / D-A; see persona-schema-v10-migration-vorbereitung.md §6).

wat_bridge_overrides.description: RESERVED, no semantics in persona-v2. Anticipated owner: wat-eng-slot (per-persona WAT-frame ingestion overrides). Reserved-but-empty hashes the same as absent under the canonical-subset drop-empty discipline.

container_bridge_spec.description: RESERVED, no semantics in persona-v2. Anticipated owner: container-ops-slot (Zone-J persona-container-bridge override; Sprint-3 likely consumes it). Reserved-but-empty hashes the same as absent under the canonical-subset drop-empty discipline.
